note: The agent roster. Each agent: its own config (agents/<id>/, core in config/), its own state (state/agents/<id>/, core in state/), its own keys (HL_AGENT_KEY_<ID> secrets; core uses HL_AGENT_KEY), its own pot and kill switch. The dashboard lists them in this order.

agents.name: Core
agents.desc: 12-14 names, 4h flips, Bitcoin gate. The original rules; best backtested edge, fewest trades.

agents.name: Wide
agents.desc: 31 liquid names, 4h flips, no Bitcoin gate. About 1.7x the trades, smaller edge.

agents.name: Fast
agents.desc: 31 names, 1h flips inside 4h/daily/weekly. Most trades; no edge proven in backtest. Paper experiment.
